data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Airport tab, airport entry, start and end dates, sort) and names the same four parameters, but it adds an unobserved "Click Search" step, treats dates and sort as required when they are optional, and gives no detail on how to pick the date cells or the sort option.
